Semantic summary: reached from Shop_ConfirmPartyAction (main:080b29a8) once its own yes/no confirmation for a pending shop->party_action (a treatment kind: 0=revive HP<=0, 1/2/3=clear a status flag, priced value*20/10/50/value*10 respectively) succeeds. Both message-id error paths (insufficient funds and Func_080b0664-gated rejection) and the message-base register reuse for msg+1/+2/+3/+4 (0xd27..0xd2b) are confirmed structurally correct against the reference -- only which physical register carries which value differs.
